translations.literal: For this reason, among provincial graduates, none enter selection unless their hair is white and teeth gone.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason, among provincial graduates, none entered selection unless their hair was white and their teeth gone;

sentences.zh: 人或裹足毀裳，息心仕進。

translations.literal: Some wrap their feet and tear their garments, abandoning all ambition for office.
translations.idiomatic: some wrapped their feet and tore their garments, abandoning all ambition for office.

sentences.zh: 夫鄉舉豈乏才良，宜令勉就是途，因行激勸。」

translations.literal: Surely the provincial graduates are not lacking in talent and worth; they ought to be encouraged to pursue this path, and thereby be spurred on.」
translations.idiomatic: Surely the provincial graduates were not lacking in talent and worth; they ought to be encouraged to pursue this path, and thereby be spurred on.」

sentences.zh: 詔皆俞允。

translations.literal: The edicts approved all of these.
translations.idiomatic: The edicts approved all of these.

sentences.zh: 再遷左給事中，勘事貴州。

translations.literal: Promoted again to Left Supervising Secretary, sent to investigate affairs in Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted again to Left Supervising Secretary and sent to investigate affairs in Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 中道罷遣，遂請急歸。

translations.literal: Midway he was dismissed and sent home, whereupon he requested urgent leave to return.
translations.idiomatic: Midway he was dismissed and sent home, whereupon he requested urgent leave to return.

sentences.zh: 神宗嗣位，起戶科給事中。

translations.literal: When the Shenzong Emperor succeeded to the throne, he was recalled as supervising secretary of the Bureau of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: When the Shenzong Emperor succeeded to the throne, he was recalled as supervising secretary of the Bureau of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 萬曆元年，平江伯陳王謨以太后家姻，夤緣得鎮湖廣。

translations.literal: Wanli year one, the Earl of Pingjiang, Chen Wangmo, through kinship with the empress dowager's family, maneuvered to obtain command of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Wanli, the Earl of Pingjiang, Chen Wangmo, through kinship with the empress dowager's family, maneuvered to obtain command of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 三近劾其垢穢，乃不遣。

translations.literal: Sanjin impeached him for filth and corruption, and so he was not dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjin impeached him for filth and corruption, and so he was not dispatched.

sentences.zh: 給事中雒遵、御史景嵩、韓必顯劾譚綸被謫，三近率同列救之，詔增供用庫黃蠟歲二萬五千，三近等又諫，皆不從。

translations.literal: When Supervising Secretary Luo Zun and Censors Jing Song and Han Bixian impeached Tan Lun and were punished, Sanjin led his colleagues to save them; when an edict increased the annual supply of yellow wax to the Supplies Treasury by twenty-five thousand, Sanjin and others remonstrated again — all were ignored.
translations.idiomatic: When Supervising Secretary Luo Zun and Censors Jing Song and Han Bixian impeached Tan Lun and were punished, Sanjin led his colleagues to save them; when an edict increased the annual supply of yellow wax to the Supplies Treasury by twenty-five thousand, Sanjin and others remonstrated again — all were ignored.

sentences.zh: 時方行海運，多覆舟，以三近言罷其役。

translations.literal: Sea transport was then in use, and many boats capsized; on Sanjin's advice the service was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: Sea transport was then in use, and many boats capsized; on Sanjin's advice the service was abolished.

sentences.zh: 肅王縉貴，隆慶間用賄以輔國將軍襲封，至是又請復莊田，三近再疏爭，遂弗予。

translations.literal: Prince Su, Jingui, had during Longqing used bribes to inherit the title through the rank of State Assisting General; now he again petitioned to recover his estate lands; Sanjin remonstrated twice, and the request was denied.
translations.idiomatic: Prince Su, Jingui, had during Longqing used bribes to inherit the title through the rank of State Assisting General; now he again petitioned to recover his estate lands; Sanjin remonstrated twice, and the request was denied.

sentences.zh: 初，有令征賦以八分為率，不及者議罰。

translations.literal: Initially there was an order that tax collection follow a rate of eighty percent, with punishment proposed for those who fell short.
translations.idiomatic: Initially there was an order that tax collection follow a rate of eighty percent, with punishment proposed for those who fell short.

sentences.zh: 三近請地雕敝者減一分，詔從之。

translations.literal: Sanjin petitioned that in ravaged districts the rate be reduced by one tenth; the edict agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Sanjin petitioned that in ravaged districts the rate be reduced by one tenth; the edict agreed.

sentences.zh: 中官溫泰請盡輸關稅、鹽課於內庫，三近言課稅本餉邊，今屯田半蕪，開中法壞，塞下所資惟此，茍歸內帑，必誤邊計。

translations.literal: Eunuch Wen Tai petitioned that all customs duties and salt levies be remitted to the inner treasury; Sanjin said that these taxes were originally meant to supply the frontier; now half the garrison farms lie waste, the frontier-provisioning salt-exchange system is broken, and the border relies on this alone — if it goes to the inner purse, the frontier plan will surely be ruined.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch Wen Tai petitioned that all customs duties and salt levies be remitted to the inner treasury; Sanjin said that these taxes were originally meant to supply the frontier; now half the garrison farms lay waste, the frontier-provisioning salt-exchange system was broken, and the border relied on this alone — if it went to the inner purse, the frontier plan would surely be ruined.

sentences.zh: 議乃寢。

translations.literal: The proposal was then shelved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was then shelved.

sentences.zh: 頃之，擢太常少卿。

translations.literal: Before long he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Before long he was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 再遷南京光祿卿，請假歸。

translations.literal: Transferred again to Director of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Entertainments; he requested leave to return home.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred again to Director of the Nanjing Court of Imperial Entertainments and requested leave to return home.

sentences.zh: 十二年，召掌光祿，其秋，拜右僉都御史，巡撫保定。

translations.literal: Year twelve, summoned to head the Court of Imperial Entertainments; that autumn, appointed Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Baoding.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was summoned to head the Court of Imperial Entertainments; that autumn he was appointed Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Baoding.

sentences.zh: 畿輔大饑，振貸有方。

translations.literal: The capital region suffered great famine; he distributed relief with proper methods.
translations.idiomatic: The capital region suffered great famine; he distributed relief with proper methods.

sentences.zh: 召拜大理卿。

translations.literal: Summoned and appointed Director of the Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed Director of the Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 未上，以親老歸養。

translations.literal: Before taking office, he returned home to care for his aged parents.
translations.idiomatic: Before taking office, he returned home to care for his aged parents.

sentences.zh: 起兵部右侍郎，復以親老辭，不許。

translations.literal: Raised to Right Vice Minister of War; again he declined on grounds of aged parents, but was not permitted.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to Right Vice Minister of War, again declined on grounds of aged parents, but was not permitted.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon after he died.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he died.

sentences.zh: 李頤，字惟貞，余幹人。

translations.literal: Li Yi, courtesy name Weizhen, was a native of Yugan.
translations.idiomatic: Li Yi, courtesy name Weizhen, was a native of Yugan.

sentences.zh: 隆慶二年進士。

translations.literal: Longqing year two jinshi.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the second year of Longqing.

sentences.zh: 授中書舍人。

translations.literal: Appointed a secretary in the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed a secretary in the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 博習典故，負才名。

translations.literal: Broadly versed in institutional precedent, he bore a reputation for talent.
translations.idiomatic: He was broadly versed in institutional precedent and bore a reputation for talent.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初，擢御史。

translations.literal: Early Wanli, promoted censor.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Wanli reign he was promoted to censor.

sentences.zh: 同官胡涍、景嵩、韓必顯，給事中雒遵相繼獲譴，抗疏申救，不聽。

translations.literal: His colleagues Hu Qiao, Jing Song, and Han Bixian, and Supervising Secretary Luo Zun, were successively punished; he submitted forceful memorials in their defense, but his pleas went unheeded.
translations.idiomatic: His colleagues Hu Qiao, Jing Song, and Han Bixian, and Supervising Secretary Luo Zun, were successively punished; he submitted forceful memorials in their defense, but his pleas went unheeded.

sentences.zh: 清軍湖廣、廣西，請免士民遠戍，只充傍近衛所軍，制可。

translations.literal: While inspecting troops in Huguang and Guangxi, he petitioned to exempt local gentry and commoners from distant frontier service, allowing them to serve only in nearby guard units; the order was approved.
translations.idiomatic: While inspecting troops in Huguang and Guangxi, he petitioned to exempt local gentry and commoners from distant frontier service, allowing them to serve only in nearby guard units; the order was approved.

sentences.zh: 忤張居正，出為湖州知府。

translations.literal: He offended Zhang Juzheng and was sent out as prefect of Huzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He offended Zhang Juzheng and was sent out as prefect of Huzhou.

sentences.zh: 遷蘇松兵備副使、湖廣按察使。

translations.literal: Transferred to vice commissioner for military defense in Su-Song, then provincial surveillance commissioner of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice commissioner for military defense in Su-Song, then provincial surveillance commissioner of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 鄖陽兵變，知府沈鈇且得罪，頤為白其冤，而密殲首亂者。

translations.literal: During the military mutiny at Yunyang, Prefect Shen Fu was about to be punished; Yi cleared his innocence while secretly destroying the ringleaders of the revolt.
translations.idiomatic: During the military mutiny at Yunyang, Prefect Shen Fu was about to be punished; Yi cleared his innocence while secretly destroying the ringleaders of the revolt.

sentences.zh: 以母喪歸。

translations.literal: He returned home upon his mother's death.
translations.idiomatic: He returned home upon his mother's death.

sentences.zh: 起故官，蒞陜西，進河南右布政使。

translations.literal: Recalled to his former rank, he went to Shaanxi and was promoted to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Recalled to his former rank, he went to Shaanxi and was promoted to Right Provincial Administration Commissioner of Henan.

sentences.zh: 擢右僉都御史，巡撫順天。

translations.literal: Promoted to Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and Grand Coordinator of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 進右副都御史。

translations.literal: Promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 以定亂兵進兵部右侍郎。

translations.literal: For pacifying the mutinous troops he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: For pacifying the mutinous troops he was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 長昂桀驁，頤與總兵王保擒其心腹小郎兒等七人，賊遂軿。

translations.literal: Chang Ang was arrogant and defiant; Yi, together with Regional Commander Wang Bao, captured seven of his close followers including Xiao Lang'er, and the bandits thereafter submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Ang was arrogant and defiant; Yi, together with Regional Commander Wang Bao, captured seven of his close followers including Xiao Lang'er, and the bandits thereafter submitted.

sentences.zh: 已，別部伯牙入寇，督將士敗之羅文峪，進左侍郎。

translations.literal: Soon after, another band under Boya invaded; he directed officers and soldiers to defeat them at Luowen Valley and was promoted to Left Vice Minister.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, another band under Boya invaded; he directed officers and soldiers to defeat them at Luowen Valley and was promoted to Left Vice Minister.

sentences.zh: 久之，進右都御史。

translations.literal: After some time he was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he was promoted to Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 時礦稅使四出。

translations.literal: At that time mining-tax commissioners were sent out in every direction.
translations.idiomatic: At that time mining-tax commissioners were sent out in every direction.

sentences.zh: 馬堂駐天津，王忠駐昌平，王虎駐保定，張曄駐通州。

translations.literal: Ma Tang was stationed at Tianjin, Wang Zhong at Changping, Wang Hu at Baoding, and Zhang Ye at Tongzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Tang was stationed at Tianjin, Wang Zhong at Changping, Wang Hu at Baoding, and Zhang Ye at Tongzhou.

sentences.zh: 頤疏言：「燕京王氣所鐘，去陵寢近，開鑿必損靈氣。」

translations.literal: Yi submitted a memorial saying: 「The capital region is where the royal aura gathers; it lies close to the imperial tombs — excavation will surely impair the numinous force.」
translations.idiomatic: Yi submitted a memorial saying: 「The capital region is where the royal aura gathers; it lies close to the imperial tombs — excavation will surely impair the numinous force.」

sentences.zh: 又言：「畿輔地荒歲儉，而敕使誅求，不遺纖屑，恐臨清激變之慘，復見輦轂下。」

translations.literal: He also said: 「The capital region's land is barren and years are lean, yet imperial envoys extract without leaving the smallest scrap; I fear the horrors of the Linqing outbreak may again appear beneath the imperial wheels.」
translations.idiomatic: He also said: 「The capital region's land is barren and years are lean, yet imperial envoys extract without leaving the smallest scrap; I fear the horrors of the Linqing outbreak may again appear beneath the imperial wheels.」

sentences.zh: 已，遼東稅使高淮誣劾山海同知羅大器，頤復言：「內監外僚，初無統攝，且遼陽礦稅，何預薊門？

translations.literal: Soon after, the Liaodong tax commissioner Gao Huai falsely impeached Subprefect Luo Daqi of Shanhai; Yi again said: 「Inner eunuchs and outer officials originally have no command relationship; moreover, how does Liaoyang's mining tax concern Ji's gates?
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, the Liaodong tax commissioner Gao Huai falsely impeached Subprefect Luo Daqi of Shanhai; Yi again said: 「Inner eunuchs and outer officials originally have no command relationship; moreover, how does Liaoyang's mining tax concern Ji's gates?

sentences.zh: 若皆效淮所為，有司將無遺類。

translations.literal: If all follow Huai's example, there will soon be no officials left.
translations.idiomatic: If all follow Huai's example, there will soon be no officials left.

sentences.zh: 陛下奉天之權，制馭宇內，今盡落宦豎手，朝奏夕報，如響應聲。

translations.literal: Your Majesty holds Heaven's mandate and governs all within the realm, yet now this has wholly fallen into eunuchs' hands — memorials filed in the morning are answered by evening, like echo answering sound.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty holds Heaven's mandate and governs all within the realm, yet now this has wholly fallen into eunuchs' hands — memorials filed in the morning are answered by evening, like echo answering sound.

sentences.zh: 縱所劾當罪，尚非所以為名，何況無辜，暴加摧折。」

translations.literal: Even if those impeached were guilty, this would still not be fit for reputation — how much less when the innocent are violently broken!」
translations.idiomatic: Even if those impeached were guilty, this would still not befit Your Majesty's reputation — how much less when the innocent are violently broken!」

sentences.zh: 皆不報。

translations.literal: All went unanswered.
translations.idiomatic: All went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 頤在鎮十年，威望大著。

translations.literal: Yi held his post at the frontier for ten years, and his prestige grew greatly.
translations.idiomatic: Yi held his post for ten years, and his prestige grew greatly.

sentences.zh: 中使憚頤廉正，畿民少安。

translations.literal: Eunuch envoys feared Yi's integrity and uprightness, and the people of the capital region found a measure of peace.
translations.idiomatic: Eunuch envoys feared Yi's integrity and uprightness, and the people of the capital region found a measure of peace.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，以工部右侍郎代劉東星管理河道。

translations.literal: Year twenty-nine, as Right Vice Minister of Works he replaced Liu Dongxing in managing the waterways.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year, as Right Vice Minister of Works he replaced Liu Dongxing in managing the waterways.

sentences.zh: 議上築決口，下疏故道，為經久計。

translations.literal: He proposed building up the breached levee above and dredging the old channel below, as a lasting plan.
translations.idiomatic: He proposed building up the breached levee above and dredging the old channel below, as a lasting plan.

sentences.zh: 甫兩月，以勞卒。

translations.literal: After only two months he died from exhaustion.
translations.idiomatic: After only two months he died from exhaustion.

sentences.zh: 贈兵部尚書。

translations.literal: Posthumously granted Minister of War.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted Minister of War.

sentences.zh: 頤仕宦三十餘年，敝車羸馬，布衣蔬食。

translations.literal: Yi served in office for more than thirty years, with a worn cart and weak horses, coarse cloth and simple food.
translations.idiomatic: Yi served in office for more than thirty years, with a worn cart and weak horses, coarse cloth and simple food.

sentences.zh: 初為御史，首請祀胡居仁於文廟，寢未行。

translations.literal: When he first became a censor, he was the first to petition sacrifice to Hu Juren in the Confucian temple; the proposal was shelved and not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: When he first became a censor, he was the first to petition sacrifice to Hu Juren in the Confucian temple; the proposal was shelved and not carried out.

sentences.zh: 見居仁裔孫希祖幼且貧，字以女，養之於家。

translations.literal: Seeing Hu Juren's descendant Sun Xizu young and poor, he betrothed his daughter to him and raised him in his household.
translations.idiomatic: When he saw that Hu Juren's descendant Sun Xizu was still young and poor, he betrothed his daughter to him and brought him up in his own home.

sentences.zh: 弟謙早卒，以己蔭畀其子。

translations.literal: His younger brother Qian died early; he gave his own hereditary privilege to Qian's son.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Qian had died young, so he transferred his own hereditary privilege to Qian's son.

sentences.zh: 朱鴻謨，字文甫，益都人。

translations.literal: Zhu Hongmo, courtesy name Wenfu, was a native of Yidu.
translations.idiomatic: Zhu Hongmo, styled Wenfu, came from Yidu.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in Longqing 5.

sentences.zh: 授吉安推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate-judge of Ji'an.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate-judge of Ji'an.

sentences.zh: 識鄒元標於諸生，厚禮之。

translations.literal: He recognized Zou Yuanbiao among the students and treated him with great courtesy.
translations.idiomatic: Among the students he recognized Zou Yuanbiao and honored him with exceptional courtesy.

sentences.zh: 擢南京御史。

translations.literal: He was promoted to censor at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to censor at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 元標及吳中行等得罪，鴻謨疏救，語侵居正，斥為民。

translations.literal: When Yuanbiao and Wu Zhongxing and others offended authority, Hongmo memorialized to rescue them; his language impugned Zhang Juzheng, and he was reduced to commoner status.
translations.idiomatic: When Yuanbiao, Wu Zhongxing, and the others fell afoul of power, Hongmo submitted a rescue memorial whose language impugned Zhang Juzheng; he was stripped of office and reduced to commoner status.

sentences.zh: 鴻謨歸，杜門講學，不入城市。

translations.literal: Hongmo returned home, closed his doors to lecture on learning, and did not enter the cities.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmo went home, shut his doors to teach, and no longer entered the cities.

sentences.zh: 居正卒，起故官，出按江西。

translations.literal: When Juzheng died, he was restored to his former office and went out to inspect Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: After Juzheng's death he was restored to his former rank and sent out to inspect Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 奏蠲水災賦，請減饒州磁器，不報。

translations.literal: He memorialized to remit flood-tax levies and asked to reduce Raozhou porcelain tribute; no reply came.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized for remission of flood levies and asked that Raozhou porcelain tribute be reduced; the court gave no answer.

sentences.zh: 又疏薦建言削籍者，忤旨，奪俸。

translations.literal: Again he memorialized recommending those who had been stripped of registration for speaking out; this defied the imperial will, and his salary was suspended.
translations.idiomatic: He memorialized again recommending officials who had been struck from the rolls for remonstrance; the memorial defied the throne, and his salary was cut.

sentences.zh: 擢光祿少卿。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments.

sentences.zh: 由大理少卿擢右僉都御史，提督操江。

translations.literal: From Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review he was promoted to Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and put in charge of training the Yangtze naval forces.
translations.idiomatic: From Vice Director of the Court of Judicial Review he rose to Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief and was put in charge of the Yangtze river patrol.

sentences.zh: 改撫應天、蘇州十府。

translations.literal: He was transferred to govern the ten prefectures of Yingtian and Suzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern the ten prefectures of Yingtian and Suzhou.

sentences.zh: 引二祖節儉之德，請裁上供織造，報聞。

translations.literal: Citing the frugality of the two founding emperors, he asked to cut imperial tribute weaving; the court acknowledged receipt.
translations.idiomatic: Invoking the frugal virtue of the dynasty's two founders, he asked that imperial tribute weaving be reduced; the court acknowledged the memorial.

sentences.zh: 吳中徭役不均，令一以田為準，不及百畝者無役，縣為立籍，定等差。

translations.literal: Corvée in Wu was uneven; he ordered that land alone serve as the standard: those with less than one hundred mu owed no corvée; each county was to establish registers and fix graded obligations.
translations.idiomatic: Corvée service in Wu was unequal, so he ruled that land alone would determine obligation: households with less than a hundred mu owed no corvée, and each county was to keep registers and fix graded dues.

sentences.zh: 貴遊子弟恣里中，無賴者與共為非，遠近訛言謂有不軌謀。

translations.literal: Noble scions ran wild in the villages; ruffians joined them in misdeeds, and rumors near and far claimed there was a seditious plot.
translations.idiomatic: Young men of noble families ran riot through the countryside; ruffians joined them in wrongdoing, and from near and far came rumors of a seditious plot.

sentences.zh: 鴻謨盡捕之，上疏告變。

translations.literal: Hongmo seized them all and memorialized to report the emergency.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmo arrested them all and memorialized to report the emergency.

sentences.zh: 朝議將用兵，兵部主事伍袁萃亟言於尚書石星，令覆勘，乃解。

translations.literal: The court debated sending troops; the Ministry of War clerk Wu Yuancui urgently spoke to Minister Shi Xing, had the case reinvestigated, and the crisis was resolved.
translations.idiomatic: The court was on the verge of mobilizing troops when Ministry of War clerk Wu Yuancui urgently appealed to Minister Shi Xing to have the case reinvestigated, and the affair was settled.

sentences.zh: 鴻謨尋入為刑部右侍郎，卒官。

translations.literal: Hongmo soon entered the capital as Right Vice Minister of Justice and died in office.
translations.idiomatic: Hongmo soon entered the capital as Right Vice Minister of Justice and died in office.

sentences.zh: 不能斂，僚屬醵金以辦。

translations.literal: There was not enough for burial; colleagues pooled funds to arrange it.
translations.idiomatic: His estate could not cover burial expenses, so his colleagues pooled money to see to the funeral.

sentences.zh: 贈刑部尚書，謚恭介。

translations.literal: He was posthumously made Minister of Justice and granted the posthumous name Gongjie.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously made Minister of Justice and granted the posthumous name Gongjie, 「Respectful and Upright.」

sentences.zh: 蕭彥，字思學，涇縣人。

translations.literal: Xiao Yan, courtesy name Sixue, was a native of Jing County.
translations.idiomatic: Xiao Yan, styled Sixue, came from Jing County.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in Longqing 5.

sentences.zh: 除杭州推官。

translations.literal: He was appointed magistrate-judge of Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed magistrate-judge of Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三年，擢兵科給事中。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Military Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 3 he was promoted to supervising secretary in the Military Bureau.

sentences.zh: 自塞上多警，邊吏輒假招降幸賞。

translations.literal: Since the frontier was often alarmed, border officials repeatedly used feigned surrender to win rewards.
translations.idiomatic: With the northern frontier constantly on alert, border officials repeatedly used false surrender to win rewards.

sentences.zh: 彥言：「議招逆黨，為中國逋亡設耳，乃欲以此招漠北敵人。

translations.literal: Yan said: 「The plan to recruit surrendered rebels was meant for fugitives within China alone, yet now they would use it to recruit enemies from beyond the northern deserts.
translations.idiomatic: Yan said: 「The policy of accepting rebel surrender was devised for fugitives within China, yet now they would use it to win over enemies from beyond the northern deserts.

sentences.zh: 夫李俊、滿四等休養百年，稱亂一旦，降人不可處內地明矣。

translations.literal: Li Jun, Man Si, and the like rested a hundred years and then rebelled in a day; it is already clear that surrendered people must not be settled in the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Men like Li Jun and Man Si had lain quiet for a century and then rose in rebellion overnight — it is already plain that surrendered peoples must not be settled in the interior.

sentences.zh: 宜一切報罷。」

translations.literal: All such proposals should be rejected outright.」
translations.idiomatic: Every such proposal should be rejected outright.」

sentences.zh: 從之。

translations.literal: The court followed his advice.
translations.idiomatic: The court followed his advice.

sentences.zh: 以工科左給事中閱視陜西四鎮邊務。

translations.literal: As Left Supervising Secretary in the Works Bureau he inspected frontier affairs in the four garrisons of Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: As Left Supervising Secretary in the Works Bureau he inspected frontier affairs in Shaanxi's four garrisons.

sentences.zh: 還奏訓兵、儲餉十事，並允行。

translations.literal: On his return he memorialized ten items on training troops and storing provisions; all were approved.
translations.idiomatic: On returning he submitted ten proposals on drilling troops and stockpiling provisions, and all were approved.

sentences.zh: 尋進戶科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to Chief Supervising Secretary in the Revenue Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Chief Supervising Secretary in the Revenue Bureau.

sentences.zh: 初，行丈量法，延、寧二鎮益田萬八千餘頃。

translations.literal: At first, when the land-measurement law was applied, the Yan and Ning garrisons gained more than eighteen thousand additional qing of fields.
translations.idiomatic: When the land-measurement law was first applied, the Yan and Ning garrisons gained more than eighteen thousand additional qing of fields.

sentences.zh: 總督高文薦請三年征賦，彥言：「西北墾荒永免科稅，祖制也。

translations.literal: Governor-General Gao Wenjian asked to levy taxes on the new fields for three years; Yan said: 「Reclaimed land in the northwest is permanently exempt from taxation by ancestral institution.
translations.idiomatic: Governor-General Gao Wenjian asked to levy taxes on the new fields for three years; Yan said: 「Reclaimed land in the northwest is permanently exempt from taxation by ancestral institution.

sentences.zh: 況二鎮多沙磧，奈何定永額，使初集流庸懷去誌。」

translations.literal: Moreover, much of the two garrisons is sandy waste — how can a permanent quota be fixed and make newly gathered vagrants think of leaving?」
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, much of the two garrisons is sandy waste — how can a permanent quota be fixed and still expect newly gathered vagrants not to think of leaving?」

sentences.zh: 遂除前令。

translations.literal: The earlier order was therefore revoked.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier order was therefore revoked.

sentences.zh: 詔購金珠，已，停市，而命以其直輸內庫。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the purchase of gold and pearls; later the market was halted, but the command remained that their value be paid into the inner treasury.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the purchase of gold and pearls; the market was later halted, but officials were still commanded to pay the price into the inner treasury.

sentences.zh: 彥言不當虛外府以實內藏，不聽。

translations.literal: Yan said the outer treasuries should not be emptied to fill the inner storehouse; the emperor would not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Yan argued that the outer treasuries should not be emptied to fill the inner storehouse; the emperor would not listen.

sentences.zh: 尋上言：「察吏之道，不宜視催科為殿最。

translations.literal: Soon after he submitted a memorial saying: 「The way to inspect officials should not treat tax collection as the sole criterion for ranking.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after he submitted a memorial saying: 「The way to inspect officials should not treat tax collection as the sole criterion for ranking.

sentences.zh: 昨隆慶五年詔征賦不及八分者，停有司俸。

translations.literal: Previously, in the fifth year of Longqing, an edict held that officials whose tax collection fell short of eighty percent would have their salaries suspended.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, in Longqing 5, an edict held that officials whose tax collection fell short of eighty percent would have their salaries suspended.

sentences.zh: 至萬曆四年則又以九分為及格，仍令帶征宿負二分，是民歲輸十分以上也。

translations.literal: By the fourth year of Wanli the passing mark had become ninety percent, yet officials were still required to collect two percent of old arrears along with the current levy — meaning the people paid more than ten percent each year.
translations.idiomatic: By Wanli 4 the passing mark had become ninety percent, yet officials were still required to collect two percent of old arrears along with the current levy — meaning the people paid more than ten percent each year.

sentences.zh: 有司憚考成，必重以敲撲。

translations.literal: Fearing the performance evaluation, officials were sure to rely heavily on beating and flogging.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing the performance evaluation, officials were sure to rely heavily on beating and flogging.

sentences.zh: 民力不勝，則流亡隨之。

translations.literal: When the people's strength could not bear it, flight followed.
translations.idiomatic: When the people's strength could not bear it, flight followed.

sentences.zh: 臣以為九分與帶征二議，不宜並行。

translations.literal: I hold that the two policies of the ninety-percent standard and the collection of arrears should not be enforced together.
translations.idiomatic: I hold that the ninety-percent standard and the collection of arrears should not be enforced together.

sentences.zh: 所謂寬一分，民受一分之賜也。」

translations.literal: What is called granting one percent of relief is granting the people one percent of grace.」
translations.idiomatic: What is called granting one percent of relief is granting the people one percent of grace.」

sentences.zh: 部議允行。

translations.literal: The ministry deliberated and approved.
translations.idiomatic: The ministry deliberated and approved.

sentences.zh: 未幾，浙江巡撫張佳胤復以舊例請，部又從之。

translations.literal: Before long, Zhejiang Governor Zhang Jiayin again petitioned under the old rule, and the ministry again agreed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long, Zhejiang Governor Zhang Jiayin again petitioned under the old rule, and the ministry again agreed.

sentences.zh: 彥疏爭，乃詔如新令。

translations.literal: Yan memorialized in protest, and an edict then followed the new rule.
translations.idiomatic: Yan memorialized in protest, and an edict then restored the new rule.

sentences.zh: 詔取黃金三千二百兩，彥請納戶部言減其半，不從。

translations.literal: An edict ordered three thousand two hundred taels of gold; Yan asked, following the Revenue Ministry's recommendation, to reduce the amount by half; the emperor would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered three thousand two hundred taels of gold; Yan asked, following the Revenue Ministry's recommendation, to cut the amount in half; the emperor refused.

sentences.zh: 擢太常少卿，以右僉都御史巡撫貴州。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and, as Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, was sent to govern Guizhou.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and, as Right Assistant Censor-in-Chief, was sent to govern Guizhou.

sentences.zh: 都勻答千巖苗叛，土官蒙詔不能制，彥檄副使楊寅秋破擒之。

translations.literal: The Dajianyan Miao of Duyun rebelled; native official Meng Zhao could not suppress them; Yan dispatched Vice Commissioner Yang Yinqiu, who broke them and captured the rebels.
translations.idiomatic: When the Dajianyan Miao of Duyun rebelled and native official Meng Zhao could not suppress them, Yan dispatched Vice Commissioner Yang Yinqiu, who routed them and took the rebels captive.

sentences.zh: 宣慰安國亨詭言獻大木，被賚。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner An Guoheng falsely claimed to offer great timber and was rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification Commissioner An Guoheng falsely claimed to present great timber and was rewarded.

sentences.zh: 及征木無有，為彥所劾。

translations.literal: When timber was demanded and none existed, Yan impeached him.
translations.idiomatic: When timber was demanded and none was found, Yan impeached him.

sentences.zh: 國亨懼，誣商奪其木，訐彥於朝。

translations.literal: Guoheng feared this, falsely accused merchants of seizing his timber, and denounced Yan at court.
translations.idiomatic: Guoheng, in fear, falsely accused merchants of seizing his timber and denounced Yan at court.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，欲罪彥。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and wished to punish Yan.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was enraged and wished to punish Yan.

sentences.zh: 大學士申時行等言國亨反噬，輕朝廷，帝乃止。

translations.literal: Grand Secretaries Shen Shixing and others said Guoheng had counter-attacked and slighted the court; the emperor then desisted.
translations.idiomatic: Grand Secretaries Shen Shixing and others said Guoheng had turned on his accuser and slighted the court; the emperor then desisted.

sentences.zh: 改撫雲南。

translations.literal: He was transferred to govern Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to govern Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 時用師隴川，副將鄧子龍不善御軍，兵大噪，守備姜忻撫定之。

translations.literal: At that time troops were being used in Longchuan; Vice General Deng Zilong was poor at commanding soldiers, and the army raised a great uproar; Garrison Commandant Jiang Xin pacified them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time troops were being deployed in Longchuan; Vice General Deng Zilong was poor at commanding soldiers, and the army raised a great uproar until Garrison Commandant Jiang Xin pacified them.

sentences.zh: 而其兵素驕，給餉少緩，遂作亂。

translations.literal: But the troops had long been arrogant, and when pay was briefly delayed they mutinied.
translations.idiomatic: But the troops had long been arrogant, and when pay was briefly delayed they mutinied.

sentences.zh: 鼓行至永昌，趨大理，抵瀾滄，過會城。

translations.literal: Beating drums, they marched to Yongchang, pressed on to Dali, reached Lancang, and passed through Huicheng.
translations.idiomatic: Beating drums, they marched to Yongchang, pressed on to Dali, reached Lancang, and passed through Huicheng.

sentences.zh: 彥調土、漢兵夾攻之，斬首八十，脅從皆撫散。

translations.literal: Yan deployed native and Han troops to attack them from both sides, beheaded eighty men, and dispersed all who had been coerced to follow.
translations.idiomatic: Yan deployed native and Han troops to attack them from both sides, beheaded eighty men, and dispersed all who had been coerced to follow.

sentences.zh: 事聞，賚銀幣。

translations.literal: When the affair was reported, he was rewarded with silver and silks.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was reported, he was rewarded with silver and silks.

sentences.zh: 自緬甸叛，孟養、車裏二宣慰久不貢。

translations.literal: Since the Burma rebellion, the pacification commissions of Mengyang and Cheli had long ceased tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Since the Burma rebellion, the pacification commissions of Mengyang and Cheli had long ceased paying tribute.

sentences.zh: 至是修貢，彥撫納之。

translations.literal: Now they restored tribute, and Yan received and settled them.
translations.idiomatic: Now they restored tribute, and Yan received and settled them.

sentences.zh: 尋以副都御史撫治鄖陽。

translations.literal: He was soon made Vice Censor-in-Chief and put in charge of governing Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made Vice Censor-in-Chief and put in charge of governing Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 進兵部右侍郎，總制兩廣軍務。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War and given overall command of military affairs in the Two Guangs.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of War and given overall command of military affairs in the Two Guangs.

sentences.zh: 日本躪朝鮮。

translations.literal: Japan overran Korea.
translations.idiomatic: Japan overran Korea.

sentences.zh: 會暹羅入貢，其使請勤王，尚書石星因令發兵搗日本。

translations.literal: When Siam came to pay tribute, its envoy asked to come to the throne's aid; Minister Shi Xing therefore ordered troops sent to strike at Japan.
translations.idiomatic: When Siam came to pay tribute, its envoy asked to come to the throne's aid; Minister Shi Xing therefore ordered troops sent to strike at Japan.

sentences.zh: 彥言暹羅處極西，去日本萬里，安能飛越大海，請罷其議。

translations.literal: Yan said Siam lay at the far west, ten thousand li from Japan — how could it fly across the sea? He asked that the plan be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Yan said Siam lay at the far west, ten thousand li from Japan — how could it fly across the sea? He asked that the plan be abandoned.

sentences.zh: 星執不從。

translations.literal: Xing held to his view and would not agree.
translations.idiomatic: Xing held to his view and would not agree.

sentences.zh: 既而暹羅兵卒不出。

translations.literal: In the end the Siamese troops never appeared.
translations.idiomatic: In the end the Siamese troops never appeared.

sentences.zh: 召拜戶部右侍郎，尋卒。

translations.literal: He was summoned and appointed Right Vice Minister of Revenue, and soon after died.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned and appointed Right Vice Minister of Revenue, and soon after died.

sentences.zh: 彥從同縣查鐸學，有誌行。

translations.literal: Yan had studied under Zha Duo of the same county and possessed resolve and conduct.
translations.idiomatic: Yan had studied under Zha Duo of the same county and possessed resolve and conduct.

sentences.zh: 服官明習天下事，所在見稱。

translations.literal: In office he clearly understood affairs throughout the realm, and wherever he served he was praised.
translations.idiomatic: In office he clearly understood affairs throughout the realm, and wherever he served he was praised.

sentences.zh: 後贈右都御史，謚定肅。

translations.literal: Later he was posthumously made Right Censor-in-Chief and granted the posthumous name Dingsu.
translations.idiomatic: Later he was posthumously made Right Censor-in-Chief and granted the posthumous name Dingsu, 「Steadfast and Solemn.」

sentences.zh: 弟雍，廣東按察使。

translations.literal: His younger brother Yong was Surveillance Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Yong was Surveillance Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 宦績亞於彥，而學過之。

translations.literal: His official achievements were second to Yan's, but his learning surpassed him.
translations.idiomatic: His official achievements were second to Yan's, but his learning surpassed him.

sentences.zh: 時稱「二蕭」。

translations.literal: People of the time called them 「the Two Xiaos.」
translations.idiomatic: People of the time called them 「the Two Xiaos.」

sentences.zh: 查鐸，字子警，嘉靖四十五年進士。

translations.literal: Zha Duo, courtesy name Zijing, became a jinshi in the forty-fifth year of Jiajing.
translations.idiomatic: Zha Duo, styled Zijing, passed the metropolitan examination in Jiajing 45.

sentences.zh: 隆慶時，為刑科左給事中。

translations.literal: In the Longqing reign he served as Left Supervising Secretary in the Punishments Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the Longqing reign he served as Left Supervising Secretary in the Punishments Bureau.

sentences.zh: 忤大學士高拱，出為山西參議。

translations.literal: He offended Grand Secretary Gao Gong and was sent out as Administrative Commissioner of Shanxi.
translations.idiomatic: He offended Grand Secretary Gao Gong and was sent out as Administrative Commissioner of Shanxi.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初，官廣西副使，移疾歸。

translations.literal: At the start of Wanli he served as Vice Commissioner of Guangxi, then resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of Wanli he served as Vice Commissioner of Guangxi, then resigned on grounds of illness and returned home.

sentences.zh: 繕水西書院，講王畿、錢德洪之學，後進多歸之。

translations.literal: He repaired the Shuixi Academy and lectured on the learning of Wang Ji and Qian Dehong; many younger scholars came to him.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired the Shuixi Academy and lectured on the learning of Wang Ji and Qian Dehong; many younger scholars came to him.

sentences.zh: 孫維城，字宗甫，丘縣人。

translations.literal: Sun Weicheng, courtesy name Zongfu, was a native of Qiu County.
translations.idiomatic: Sun Weicheng, styled Zongfu, came from Qiu County.

sentences.zh: 隆慶五年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of Longqing.
translations.idiomatic: He passed the metropolitan examination in Longqing 5.

sentences.zh: 歷知浚、太康、任丘三縣。

translations.literal: He successively served as magistrate of Jun, Taikang, and Renqiu.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as magistrate of Jun, Taikang, and Renqiu.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十年，擢南京御史。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Wanli he was promoted to censor at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: In Wanli 10 he was promoted to censor at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 初，張居正不奔喪，寧國諸生吳仕期欲上書諫。

translations.literal: At first, when Zhang Juzheng did not leave office to mourn his father, the Ningguo student Wu Shiji wished to submit a remonstrance.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Zhang Juzheng did not leave office to mourn his father, the Ningguo student Wu Shiji wished to submit a remonstrance.

sentences.zh: 未發，太平同知龍宗武告之操江胡槚，以聞於居正。

translations.literal: Before it was sent, Taiping Vice Prefect Long Zongwu reported it to Hu Jiao, who commanded the Yangtze patrol, and Jiao informed Juzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Before it was sent, Taiping Vice Prefect Long Zongwu reported it to Hu Jiao, who commanded the Yangtze patrol, and Jiao informed Juzheng.

sentences.zh: 會有偽為海瑞劾居正疏者，播之邸抄。

translations.literal: Then someone forged a memorial by Hai Rui impeaching Juzheng and circulated it in the palace gazette.
translations.idiomatic: Then someone forged a memorial by Hai Rui impeaching Juzheng and circulated it in the palace gazette.

sentences.zh: 宗武意仕期，遂置獄，榜掠七日而卒。

translations.literal: Zongwu suspected Shiji; he was imprisoned, beaten under torture for seven days, and died.
translations.idiomatic: Zongwu suspected Shiji; he was imprisoned, beaten under torture for seven days, and died.

sentences.zh: 居正死，仕期妻訟冤，維城疏言狀。

translations.literal: After Juzheng died, Shiji's wife petitioned about the injustice; Weicheng memorialized stating the facts.
translations.idiomatic: After Juzheng died, Shiji's wife petitioned about the injustice; Weicheng memorialized stating the facts.

sentences.zh: 槚已擢刑部侍郎，宗武湖廣參議，皆落職戍邊，天下快之。

translations.literal: Jiao had already been promoted to Vice Minister of Justice and Zongwu to Administrative Commissioner of Huguang; both were stripped of office and sent to frontier garrison, and all under Heaven rejoiced.
translations.idiomatic: Jiao had already been promoted to Vice Minister of Justice and Zongwu to Administrative Commissioner of Huguang; both were stripped of office and sent to frontier garrison, and all under Heaven rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 中官田玉提督太和山，請兼行分守事，帝許之，維城援祖制力陳不可。

translations.literal: The eunuch Tian Yu supervised Mount Taihe and asked also to hold separate-garrison duties; the emperor approved; Weicheng cited ancestral institutions and forcefully argued it was impermissible.
translations.idiomatic: The eunuch Tian Yu supervised Mount Taihe and asked also to hold separate-garrison duties; the emperor approved; Weicheng cited ancestral institutions and forcefully argued it was impermissible.

sentences.zh: 俄以救言官範俊，奪俸一年。

translations.literal: Soon after, for defending remonstrating official Fan Jun, his salary was suspended for one year.
translations.idiomatic: Soon after, for defending remonstrating official Fan Jun, his salary was suspended for one year.

sentences.zh: 忤座主大學士許國，出為永平知府。

translations.literal: He offended his chief examiner, Grand Secretary Xu Guo, and was sent out as prefect of Yongping.
translations.idiomatic: He offended his chief examiner, Grand Secretary Xu Guo, and was sent out as prefect of Yongping.

sentences.zh: 遷赤城兵備副使。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner for defense at Chicheng.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to Vice Commissioner for defense at Chicheng.

sentences.zh: 繕亭障二百六十所，招史、車二部千餘人。

translations.literal: He repaired two hundred sixty watch-pavilions and border barriers and recruited more than a thousand men from the Shi and Che divisions.
translations.idiomatic: He repaired two hundred and sixty watch-pavilions and border barriers and recruited more than a thousand men from the Shi and Che divisions.

sentences.zh: 以功屢進按察使，兵備如故。

translations.literal: For his achievements he was repeatedly promoted to surveillance commissioner while retaining his military-defense duties.
translations.idiomatic: For his achievements he was repeatedly promoted to surveillance commissioner while retaining his military-defense duties.

sentences.zh: 部長安兔挾五千騎邀賞，維城請於督、撫，革其市賞而責之，戢不敢肆。

translations.literal: The tribal leader Chang'an Tu came with five thousand horsemen to demand rewards; Weicheng appealed to the governor-general and the grand coordinator, abolished their market rewards, and held them accountable, and they dared not run riot.
translations.idiomatic: The tribal leader Chang'an Tu came with five thousand horsemen to demand rewards; Weicheng appealed to the governor-general and the grand coordinator, abolished their market rewards, and held them accountable, and they dared not run riot.

sentences.zh: 尋以右布政使移守宣府，改廣東左布政使。

translations.literal: Soon afterward, as Right Administrative Commissioner he was transferred to govern Xuanfu, then was made Left Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward, as Right Administrative Commissioner he was transferred to govern Xuanfu, then was made Left Administrative Commissioner of Guangdong.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，拜右僉都御史，巡撫延綏。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-ninth year he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 河套常犯順，罷貢市十餘年。

translations.literal: The Ordos region had long violated submission, and tribute markets had been suspended for more than ten years.
translations.idiomatic: The Ordos region had long violated submission, and tribute markets had been suspended for more than ten years.

sentences.zh: 後復松山，築邊城，諸部長恐，益侵軼。

translations.literal: Later Songshan was recovered and border cities were built; the tribal chiefs grew fearful and raided all the more.
translations.idiomatic: Later Songshan was recovered and border cities were built; the tribal chiefs grew fearful and raided all the more.

sentences.zh: 至是，吉囊、卜莊等乞款。

translations.literal: By this time Ji Nang, Buzhuang, and others begged for peace.
translations.idiomatic: By this time Ji Nang, Buzhuang, and others begged for peace.

sentences.zh: 聞巡撫王見賓當去，請益切。

translations.literal: Hearing that Grand Coordinator Wang Jianbin was about to leave, they pleaded all the more urgently.
translations.idiomatic: Hearing that Grand Coordinator Wang Jianbin was about to leave, they pleaded all the more urgently.

sentences.zh: 在寧夏者曰著宰，亦請之巡撫楊時寧。

translations.literal: The one at Ningxia called Zhuzai also petitioned Grand Coordinator Yang Shining.
translations.idiomatic: The one at Ningxia called Zhuzai also petitioned Grand Coordinator Yang Shining.

sentences.zh: 兩鎮交奏，給事中桂有根請聽邊臣自主。

translations.literal: The two garrisons memorialized jointly; Supervising Secretary Gui Yougen asked that frontier officials be allowed to decide for themselves.
translations.idiomatic: The two garrisons memorialized jointly; Supervising Secretary Gui Yougen asked that frontier officials be allowed to decide for themselves.

sentences.zh: 維城方代見賓，時寧亦遷去，以黃嘉善代，二人並申約束。

translations.literal: Weicheng was just replacing Jianbin, and Shining was also transferred away; Huang Jiashan replaced him, and the two men together imposed strict terms.
translations.idiomatic: Weicheng was just replacing Jianbin, and Shining was also transferred away; Huang Jiashan replaced him, and the two men together imposed strict terms.

sentences.zh: 維城又條善後六事，款事復堅。

translations.literal: Weicheng also set forth six measures for lasting order, and the peace agreement was again secured.
translations.idiomatic: Weicheng also set forth six measures for lasting order, and the peace agreement was again secured.

sentences.zh: 初，維城在宣府，與總兵官麻承恩不相能。

translations.literal: At first, when Weicheng was at Xuanfu, he and Regional Commander Ma Chengen did not get along.
translations.idiomatic: At first, when Weicheng was at Xuanfu, he and Regional Commander Ma Chengen did not get along.

sentences.zh: 會承恩亦移鎮延綏。

translations.literal: It happened that Chengen was also transferred to command at Yan-sui.
translations.idiomatic: It happened that Chengen was also transferred to command at Yan-sui.

sentences.zh: 一日，維城見城外積沙及城，命余丁除之。

translations.literal: One day Weicheng saw sand piled outside the wall as high as the ramparts and ordered spare laborers to clear it.
translations.idiomatic: One day Weicheng saw sand piled outside the wall as high as the ramparts and ordered spare laborers to clear it.

sentences.zh: 承恩紿其眾曰：「食不宿飽，且塞沙可盡乎？」

translations.literal: Chengen deceived the troops, saying, "You are not fed to fullness — and can the desert sand ever be cleared?
translations.idiomatic: Chengen deceived the troops, saying, "You are not fed to fullness — and can the desert sand ever be cleared?

sentences.zh: 卒遂噪。

translations.literal: The soldiers then made a clamor.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers then made a clamor.

sentences.zh: 維城曉之曰：「除城沙，以防寇耳，非謂塞上沙也。」

translations.literal: Weicheng explained to them, "Clearing sand from the wall is to guard against bandits — I do not mean the sand of the northern desert.
translations.idiomatic: Weicheng explained to them, "Clearing sand from the wall is to guard against bandits — I do not mean the sand of the northern desert.

sentences.zh: 卒悟而散。

translations.literal: The soldiers understood and dispersed.
translations.idiomatic: The soldiers understood and dispersed.

sentences.zh: 維城因自劾，帝慰留維城，治嘩者。

translations.literal: Weicheng therefore impeached himself; the emperor comforted him and kept him in office and punished those who had made the uproar.
translations.idiomatic: Weicheng therefore impeached himself; the emperor comforted him and kept him in office and punished those who had made the uproar.

sentences.zh: 然維城竟坐是得疾，不數月卒。

translations.literal: Yet Weicheng ultimately fell ill on account of this and died within a few months.
translations.idiomatic: Yet Weicheng ultimately fell ill on account of this and died within a few months.

sentences.zh: 將吏入視其橐，僅俸數金，賻而歸其喪。

translations.literal: When officers entered to view his bags, they found only a few taels of salary; they contributed funeral gifts and sent his coffin home.
translations.idiomatic: When officers entered to view his bags, they found only a few taels of salary; they contributed funeral gifts and sent his coffin home.

sentences.zh: 謝傑，字漢甫，長樂人。

translations.literal: Xie Jie, courtesy name Hanfu, was a native of Changle.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Jie, courtesy name Hanfu, was a native of Changle.

sentences.zh: 萬曆初進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi at the beginning of the Wanli reign.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi at the beginning of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 除行人。

translations.literal: He was appointed an imperial messenger.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed an imperial messenger.

sentences.zh: 冊封琉球，卻其饋。

translations.literal: When enfeoffing Ryukyu he refused their gifts.
translations.idiomatic: When enfeoffing Ryukyu he refused their gifts.

sentences.zh: 其使入謝，仍以金饋，卒言於朝而返之。

translations.literal: When their envoy came to give thanks he was again offered gold; he reported it at court and returned it.
translations.idiomatic: When their envoy came to give thanks he was again offered gold; he reported it at court and returned it.

sentences.zh: 歷兩京太常少卿。

translations.literal: He successively served as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices at both capitals.
translations.idiomatic: He successively served as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices at both capitals.

sentences.zh: 南京歲祀懿文太子，以祠祭司官代，傑言：「祝版署御名，而遣賤者將事，於禮為褻。

translations.literal: At Nanjing the annual sacrifice to the Yiwen Crown Prince was performed by an official of the Sacrificial Affairs Bureau in place of the proper officer; Jie said, "The prayer tablet bears the imperial name, yet a lowly man is sent to conduct the rite — by ritual this is profane.
translations.idiomatic: At Nanjing the annual sacrifice to the Yiwen Crown Prince was performed by an official of the Sacrificial Affairs Bureau in place of the proper officer; Jie said, "The prayer tablet bears the imperial name, yet a lowly man is sent to conduct the rite — by ritual this is profane.

sentences.zh: 請如哀沖、莊敬二太子例，遣列侯。」

translations.literal: He asked that, as in the cases of the Aichong and Zhuangjing crown princes, a marquis be dispatched.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that, as in the cases of the Aichong and Zhuangjing crown princes, a marquis be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 帝是之，乃用南京五府僉書。

translations.literal: The emperor agreed, and the five Nanjing princely establishments were used.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor agreed, and the five Nanjing princely establishments were used.

sentences.zh: 累遷順天府尹。

translations.literal: He was promoted in succession to prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted in succession to prefect of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 以右副都御史巡撫南、贛。

translations.literal: As Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he grand-coordinated southern Jiangxi and southern Gan.
translations.idiomatic: As Right Vice Censor-in-Chief he grand-coordinated southern Jiangxi and southern Gan.

sentences.zh: 屬吏被薦者以賄謝，傑曰：「賄而後薦，干戈之盜；

translations.literal: A subordinate whom he had recommended tried to thank him with a bribe; Jie said, "A bribe before recommendation is the theft of arms;
translations.idiomatic: A subordinate whom he had recommended tried to thank him with a bribe; Jie said, "A bribe before recommendation is the theft of arms;

sentences.zh: 薦而後賄，衣冠之盜。」

translations.literal: recommendation before a bribe is the theft of robes."
translations.idiomatic: recommendation before a bribe is the theft of robes."

sentences.zh: 人以為名言。

translations.literal: People regarded it as a saying worth remembering.
translations.idiomatic: People regarded it as a saying worth remembering.

sentences.zh: 進南京刑部右侍郎。

translations.literal: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Punishments at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Right Vice Minister of Punishments at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 二十五年春，傑以帝荒於政事，疏陳十規。

translations.literal: In the spring of the twenty-fifth year Jie, because the emperor neglected government, memorialized ten admonitions.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the twenty-fifth year Jie, because the emperor neglected government, memorialized ten admonitions.

sentences.zh: 言：「前此兩宮色養維一，今則定省久曠，慶賀亦疏。

translations.literal: He said: "Before this, nurturing both palaces was the sole concern; now audiences at dawn and evening are long neglected, and congratulations are also rare.
translations.idiomatic: He said: "Before this, nurturing both palaces was the sole concern; now audiences at dawn and evening are long neglected, and congratulations are also rare.

sentences.zh: 孝安太后發引，並不親送。

translations.literal: When Empress Dowager Xiao'an departed, he did not escort her in person.
translations.idiomatic: When Empress Dowager Xiao'an departed, he did not escort her in person.

sentences.zh: 前此太廟時饗皆躬親，今則皆遣代。

translations.literal: Before this the emperor personally attended seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; now he always sends substitutes.
translations.idiomatic: Before this the emperor personally attended seasonal offerings at the Imperial Ancestral Temple; now he always sends substitutes.

sentences.zh: 前此經筵臨御，聖學日勤，今則講官徒設，講席久虛。

translations.literal: Before this he attended the classics lecture in person and his sacred learning grew daily; now the lecturers are mere fixtures and the lecture seat has long stood empty.
translations.idiomatic: Before this he attended the classics lecture in person and his sacred learning grew daily; now the lecturers are mere fixtures and the lecture seat has long stood empty.

sentences.zh: 前此披星視朝，今則高拱深居，累年不出。

translations.literal: Before this he held court before dawn; now he sits deep within, and for years has not emerged.
translations.idiomatic: Before this he held court before dawn; now he sits deep within, and for years has not emerged.

sentences.zh: 前此歲旱步禱郊壇，今則圜丘大報，久缺齋居；

translations.literal: Before this, in years of drought he walked in prayer at the suburban altars; now the great report at the Circular Mound lacks long fasting;
translations.idiomatic: Before this, in years of drought he walked in prayer at the suburban altars; now the great report at the Circular Mound lacks long fasting;

sentences.zh: 宸宮告災，亦忘修省。

translations.literal: when the palace reported fire, he also forgot self-examination.
translations.idiomatic: when the palace reported fire, he also forgot self-examination.

sentences.zh: 前此四方旱澇，多發帑金，今則采礦榷稅。

translations.literal: Before this, for drought and flood throughout the realm, he often issued treasury funds; now he levies mining and transit taxes.
translations.idiomatic: Before this, for drought and flood throughout the realm, he often issued treasury funds; now he levies mining and transit taxes.

sentences.zh: 前此用財有節，今則歲進月輸；

translations.literal: Before this expenditures were restrained; now yearly and monthly deliveries increase;
translations.idiomatic: Before this expenditures were restrained; now yearly and monthly deliveries increase;

sentences.zh: 而江右之磁，江南之纻，西蜀之扇，關中之絨，率取之逾額。

translations.literal: porcelain from Jiangxi, ramie cloth from Jiangnan, fans from western Shu, and felt from Guanzhong are all taken beyond the quota.
translations.idiomatic: porcelain from Jiangxi, ramie cloth from Jiangnan, fans from western Shu, and felt from Guanzhong are all taken beyond the quota.

sentences.zh: 前此樂聞讜言，今則封事甫陳，嚴綸隨降，但經廢棄，永不賜環。

translations.literal: Before this he gladly heard blunt counsel; now as soon as a sealed memorial is submitted, stern edicts follow, and once discarded, reinstatement is never granted.
translations.idiomatic: Before this he gladly heard blunt counsel; now as soon as a sealed memorial is submitted, stern edicts follow, and once discarded, reinstatement is never granted.

sentences.zh: 前此撫恤宗室，恩義有加，今則楚藩見誣，中榼旋出，以市井奸宄，間骨肉懿親。

translations.literal: Before this he treated the imperial clan with added grace; now the Chu princely house was slandered, the inner eunuch was sent out at once, and market ruffians are set between flesh-and-blood kin.
translations.idiomatic: Before this he treated the imperial clan with added grace; now the Chu princely house was slandered, the inner eunuch was sent out at once, and market ruffians are set between flesh-and-blood kin.

sentences.zh: 前此官盛任使，下無曠鰥，今則大僚屢虛，庶官不補。

translations.literal: Before this high offices were fully staffed and no talent lay idle; now great posts often stand empty and junior posts go unfilled.
translations.idiomatic: Before this high offices were fully staffed and no talent lay idle; now great posts often stand empty and junior posts go unfilled.

sentences.zh: 是陛下孝親、尊祖，好學、勤政、敬天、愛民、節用、聽言、親親、賢賢，皆不克如初矣。」

translations.literal: Thus Your Majesty's filial piety toward kin, reverence for ancestors, love of learning, diligence in government, reverence for Heaven, love of the people, frugality, heeding counsel, cherishing kin, and honoring the worthy — none can be kept as at first.
translations.idiomatic: Thus Your Majesty's filial piety toward kin, reverence for ancestors, love of learning, diligence in government, reverence for Heaven, love of the people, frugality, heeding counsel, cherishing kin, and honoring the worthy — none can be kept as at first.

sentences.zh: 不報。

translations.literal: No reply came.
translations.idiomatic: No reply came.

sentences.zh: 召為刑部左侍郎，擢戶部尚書督倉場。

translations.literal: He was summoned as Left Vice Minister of Punishments and promoted to Minister of Revenue in charge of the granary depots.
translations.idiomatic: He was summoned as Left Vice Minister of Punishments and promoted to Minister of Revenue in charge of the granary depots.

sentences.zh: 時四方遇災，率請改折，傑請歲運必三百萬以上方許議折，從之。

translations.literal: When disasters struck everywhere, officials often asked to convert grain tax to silver; Jie ruled that annual transport must exceed three million piculs before conversion could be discussed, and this was followed.
translations.idiomatic: When disasters struck everywhere, officials often asked to convert grain tax to silver; Jie ruled that annual transport must exceed three million piculs before conversion could be discussed, and this was followed.

sentences.zh: 三十二年，卒官。

translations.literal: In the thirty-second year he died in office.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirty-second year he died in office.

sentences.zh: 初，傑父教諭廷袞家居老矣，族人假其名逋賦。

translations.literal: At first Jie's father Tinggun, an instructor, was old and living at home when clansmen borrowed his name to evade taxes.
translations.idiomatic: At first Jie's father Tinggun, an instructor, was old and living at home when clansmen borrowed his name to evade taxes.

sentences.zh: 縣令劉禹龍言於御史逮之。

translations.literal: Magistrate Liu Yulong told the censor, who had him arrested.
translations.idiomatic: Magistrate Liu Yulong told the censor, who had him arrested.

sentences.zh: 傑代訊，幾斃。

translations.literal: Jie took the interrogation in his father's place and nearly died.
translations.idiomatic: Jie took the interrogation in his father's place and nearly died.

sentences.zh: 後撫贛，禹龍家居，未嘗修隙，時服其量。

translations.literal: Later, when grand-coordinating Gan, Yulong was living at home; Jie had never nursed a grudge, and at the time people admired his magnanimity.
translations.idiomatic: Later, when grand-coordinating Gan, Yulong was living at home; Jie had never nursed a grudge, and at the time people admired his magnanimity.

sentences.zh: 郭惟賢，字哲卿，晉江人。

translations.literal: Guo Weixian, courtesy name Zheqing, was a native of Jinjiang.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Weixian, courtesy name Zheqing, was a native of Jinjiang.

sentences.zh: 萬曆二年進士。

translations.literal: He became a jinshi in the second year of Wanli.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the second year of Wanli.

sentences.zh: 自清江知縣拜南京御史。

translations.literal: From magistrate of Qingjiang he was appointed censor at Nanjing.
translations.idiomatic: From magistrate of Qingjiang he was appointed censor at Nanjing.

sentences.zh: 張居正既死，吳中行、趙用賢等猶未錄。

translations.literal: After Zhang Juzheng died, Wu Zhongxing, Zhao Yongxian, and others had still not been restored.
translations.idiomatic: After Zhang Juzheng died, Wu Zhongxing, Zhao Yongxian, and others had still not been restored.

sentences.zh: 會皇長子生，詔赦天下，惟賢因請召諸臣。

translations.literal: When the eldest imperial son was born, an amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; Weixian therefore asked that those officials be summoned back.
translations.idiomatic: When the eldest imperial son was born, an amnesty was proclaimed for all under Heaven; Weixian therefore asked that those officials be summoned back.

sentences.zh: 馮保惡其言，謫江山丞。

translations.literal: Feng Bao hated his words and demoted him to assistant magistrate of Jiangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Feng Bao hated his words and demoted him to assistant magistrate of Jiangshan.

sentences.zh: 保敗，還故官。

translations.literal: When Bao fell, Weixian was restored to his former post.
translations.idiomatic: When Bao fell, Weixian was restored to his former post.

sentences.zh: 劾左都御史陳炌希權臣指，論罷御史趙耀、趙應元，不可總憲紀。

translations.literal: He impeached Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Can for currying favor with powerful ministers, having censors Zhao Yao and Zhao Yingyuan dismissed — unfit to head the censorate.
translations.idiomatic: He impeached Left Censor-in-Chief Chen Can for currying favor with powerful ministers, having censors Zhao Yao and Zhao Yingyuan dismissed — unfit to head the censorate.

sentences.zh: 炌罷去。

translations.literal: Can was dismissed.
translations.idiomatic: Can was dismissed.

sentences.zh: 又薦王錫爵、賈三近、孫鑨、何源、孫丕揚、耿定向、曾同亨、詹仰庇，皆獲召。

translations.literal: He also recommended Wang Xijue, Jia Sanjin, Sun Long, He Yuan, Sun Bujang, Geng Dingxiang, Zeng Tongheng, and Zhan Yangbi, and all were summoned.
translations.idiomatic: He also recommended Wang Xijue, Jia Sanjin, Sun Long, He Yuan, Sun Bujang, Geng Dingxiang, Zeng Tongheng, and Zhan Yangbi, and all were summoned.

sentences.zh: 主事董基諫內操被謫，惟賢救之，忤旨，調南京大理評事。

translations.literal: Clerk Dong Ji remonstrated against inner training of troops and was demoted; Weixian rescued him, defying the imperial will, and was transferred to reviewing clerk at the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review.
translations.idiomatic: Clerk Dong Ji remonstrated against inner training of troops and was demoted; Weixian rescued him, defying the imperial will, and was transferred to reviewing clerk at the Nanjing Court of Judicial Review.

sentences.zh: 給事中阮子孝、御史潘惟嶽等交章救。

translations.literal: Supervising Secretary Ruan Zixiao and Censor Pan Weiyue and others memorialized jointly in his defense.
translations.idiomatic: Supervising Secretary Ruan Zixiao and Censor Pan Weiyue and others memorialized jointly in his defense.

sentences.zh: 帝怒，奪俸有差。

translations.literal: The emperor was angry and docked salaries by graded amounts.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was angry and docked salaries by graded amounts.

sentences.zh: 惟賢尋遷戶部主事，歷順天府丞。

translations.literal: Weixian was soon moved to principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and rose to vice prefect of Shuntian.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian was soon moved to principal clerk in the Ministry of Revenue and rose to vice prefect of Shuntian.

sentences.zh: 二十年，以右僉都御史巡撫湖廣。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Huguang.
translations.idiomatic: In the twentieth year he was appointed Right Vice Censor-in-Chief and grand coordinator of Huguang.

sentences.zh: 景王封德安，土田倍諸藩，國絕賦額猶存。

translations.literal: When the Prince of Jing was enfeoffed at De'an, his land allotment doubled other princes, yet the state's abolished tax quotas still remained.
translations.idiomatic: When the Prince of Jing was enfeoffed at De'an, his land allotment doubled other princes, yet the state's abolished tax quotas still remained.

sentences.zh: 及帝弟潞王之國衛輝，悉以景賦予王。

translations.literal: When the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Lu went to his fief at Weihui, all of Jing's tax assessment was given to the prince.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor's younger brother the Prince of Lu went to his fief at Weihui, all of Jing's tax assessment was given to the prince.

sentences.zh: 王奏賦不及額，帝為奪監司以下俸，責撫按急奏報。

translations.literal: The prince memorialized that the assessment did not reach the quota; the emperor stripped salaries from supervising officials downward and ordered the grand coordinators to report urgently.
translations.idiomatic: The prince memorialized that the assessment did not reach the quota; the emperor stripped salaries from supervising officials downward and ordered the grand coordinators to report urgently.

sentences.zh: 惟賢言：「景府賦額皆奸民投獻，妄張其數。

translations.literal: Weixian said: "The Jing fief assessments were all false numbers inflated by scheming commoners through fraudulent gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian said: "The Jing fief assessments were all false numbers inflated by scheming commoners through fraudulent gifts.

sentences.zh: 臣為王履畝，增賦二萬五千，非復如往者虛數，王反稱不足，何也？

translations.literal: I measured fields for the prince and added twenty-five thousand in assessment — no longer the former empty figures — yet the prince still says it is insufficient; why?
translations.idiomatic: I measured fields for the prince and added twenty-five thousand in assessment — no longer the former empty figures — yet the prince still says it is insufficient; why?

sentences.zh: 且潞去楚遠，莫若征之有司，轉輸潞府。

translations.literal: Moreover Lu is far from Chu; better to levy through local officials and forward payment to the Lu fief.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Lu is far from Chu; better to levy through local officials and forward payment to the Lu fief.

sentences.zh: 《會典》皇莊及勛戚官莊，遇災蠲減視民田。

translations.literal: The Statutes say that imperial estates and noble and official estates, when disaster strikes, receive tax relief like commoners' fields.
translations.idiomatic: The Statutes say that imperial estates and noble and official estates, when disaster strikes, receive tax relief like commoners' fields.

sentences.zh: 今襄、漢水溢，王佃民流亡過半，請蠲如例。」

translations.literal: Now the Han and Xiang rivers overflowed and more than half the prince's tenant farmers fled; he asked for relief by precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Now the Han and Xiang rivers overflowed and more than half the prince's tenant farmers fled; he asked for relief by precedent.

sentences.zh: 又言：「長沙、寶慶、衡州三衛軍戍武岡，而永州、寧遠諸衛遠戍廣西，瘴癘死無數。

translations.literal: He also said: "The three guards of Changsha, Baoqing, and Hengzhou garrison Wugang, while the guards of Yongzhou, Ningyuan, and others garrison Guangxi from afar — countless die of miasma.
translations.idiomatic: He also said: "The three guards of Changsha, Baoqing, and Hengzhou garrison Wugang, while the guards of Yongzhou, Ningyuan, and others garrison Guangxi from afar — countless die of miasma.

sentences.zh: 請分番叠戍武岡，罷其戍廣西者。」

translations.literal: He asked to rotate garrison at Wugang in turns and end the Guangxi garrison."
translations.idiomatic: He asked to rotate garrison at Wugang in turns and end the Guangxi garrison."

sentences.zh: 帝悉報許。

translations.literal: The emperor approved all in reply.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved all in reply.

sentences.zh: 承天守備中官以征興邸舊賦，請罪潛江知縣及諸佃民，旨下撫按勾捕。

translations.literal: The garrison eunuch at Chengtian, citing old levies of the Xing residence, asked that the magistrate of Qianjiang and tenant farmers be punished; an edict ordered the grand coordinators to arrest them.
translations.idiomatic: The garrison eunuch at Chengtian, citing old levies of the Xing residence, asked that the magistrate of Qianjiang and tenant farmers be punished; an edict ordered the grand coordinators to arrest them.

sentences.zh: 惟賢言：「臣撫楚，事無不當問。

translations.literal: Weixian said: "As grand coordinator of Chu, there is nothing I should not investigate.
translations.idiomatic: Weixian said: "As grand coordinator of Chu, there is nothing I should not investigate.

sentences.zh: 今中官問，而臣等為勾捕，臣實不能。」

translations.literal: Now the eunuch investigates while we are made to arrest — I truly cannot.
translations.idiomatic: Now the eunuch investigates while we are made to arrest — I truly cannot.

sentences.zh: 帝直其言而止。

translations.literal: The emperor upheld his words and stopped the order.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor upheld his words and stopped the order.

sentences.zh: 尋請以太和山香稅充王府逋祿，免加派小民，又請以周敦頤父輔成從祀啟聖。

translations.literal: He soon asked that Mount Taihe incense tax pay the prince's arrears in stipends and spare extra levies on commoners, and also asked that Zhou Dunyi's father Fucheng be added to sacrifice at the Sage's temple.
translations.idiomatic: He soon asked that Mount Taihe incense tax pay the prince's arrears in stipends and spare extra levies on commoners, and also asked that Zhou Dunyi's father Fucheng be added to sacrifice at the Sage's temple.

sentences.zh: 詔皆從焉。

translations.literal: Edicts approved both.
translations.idiomatic: Edicts approved both.

sentences.zh: 入為左僉都御史。

translations.literal: He entered the capital as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital as Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 言行取不宜久停，言官不宜久系，臺員不宜久缺。

translations.literal: He said that direct appointment from the provinces should not long be suspended, remonstrating officials should not long be imprisoned, and censorate posts should not long stand vacant.
translations.idiomatic: He said that direct appointment from the provinces should not long be suspended, remonstrating officials should not long be imprisoned, and censorate posts should not long stand vacant.

sentences.zh: 已，復言天下多故，乃自大僚至監司率有缺不補，政日廢弛，且建言獲譴者不下百餘人，效忠者皆永棄。

translations.literal: Later he again said that under many emergencies, from high ministers to surveillance commissioners, posts often stood vacant without filling, government daily decayed, and more than a hundred who had offered counsel had been punished — loyal men were forever cast aside.
translations.idiomatic: Later he again said that under many emergencies, from high ministers to surveillance commissioners, posts often stood vacant without filling, government daily decayed, and more than a hundred who had offered counsel had been punished — loyal men were forever cast aside.

sentences.zh: 帝不納。

translations.literal: The emperor did not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not accept it.

sentences.zh: 尋遷左副都御史。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to Left Vice Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 請早建皇儲，慎簡輔弼，亟行考選，盡下推舉諸疏。

translations.literal: He asked that the heir apparent be established early, chief assistants be chosen carefully, examinations and selections be hurried, and all recommendation memorials be fully implemented.
translations.idiomatic: He asked that the heir apparent be established early, chief assistants be chosen carefully, examinations and selections be hurried, and all recommendation memorials be fully implemented.

sentences.zh: 俱不報。

translations.literal: None received reply.
translations.idiomatic: None received reply.

sentences.zh: 久之，以憂歸。

translations.literal: After a long time, he returned home on account of grief.
translations.idiomatic: After some time he went home to mourn a bereavement.

sentences.zh: 起戶部左侍郎，未上卒。

translations.literal: He was appointed Left Vice Minister of Revenue but died before taking up the post.
translations.idiomatic: He was raised to Left Vice Minister of Revenue but died before he could assume office.

sentences.zh: 贈右都御史。

translations.literal: He was posthumously enfeoffed as Right Censor-in-Chief.
translations.idiomatic: He was posthumously granted the title Right Censor-in-Chief.

sentences.zh: 天啟初，謚恭定。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Tianqi reign he was given the posthumous epithet Gongding.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Tianqi reign he received the posthumous epithet Gongding.

sentences.zh: 萬象春，字仁甫，無錫人。

translations.literal: Wan Xiangchun, courtesy name Renfu, was a native of Wuxi.
translations.idiomatic: Wan Xiangchun, style name Renfu, came from Wuxi.

sentences.zh: 萬曆五年進士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Wanli he passed the metropolitan examination.
translations.idiomatic: He became a jinshi in the fifth year of the Wanli reign.

sentences.zh: 選庶吉士，授工科給事中。

translations.literal: He was selected as a Hanlin bachelor and appointed supervising secretary in the Ministry of Works.
translations.idiomatic: Chosen as a Hanlin bachelor, he was made a supervising secretary in the Ministry of Works.

sentences.zh: 皇女生，詔戶部、光祿寺各進銀十萬兩。

translations.literal: When a princess was born, an edict ordered the Ministries of Revenue and Court of Imperial Entertainments each to present one hundred thousand taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: On the birth of an imperial daughter, the throne ordered the Ministries of Revenue and of Imperial Entertainments each to contribute one hundred thousand taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 象春力諫，不聽。

translations.literal: Xiangchun remonstrated forcefully; the emperor did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangchun argued strenuously against it, but the emperor would not heed him.

sentences.zh: 屢遷禮科都給事中。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to chief supervising secretary in the Bureau of Rites.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through several posts to chief supervising secretary in the Bureau of Rites.

sentences.zh: 鄭貴妃有盛寵，而帝耽於酒。

translations.literal: Consort Zheng enjoyed great favor, and the emperor was addicted to wine.
translations.idiomatic: Consort Zheng was in high favor, while the emperor indulged heavily in drink.

sentences.zh: 象春因慈寧宮災疏諫，報聞。

translations.literal: Because of the fire at Cining Palace, Xiangchun submitted a memorial of remonstrance; the court acknowledged it.
translations.idiomatic: After the Cining Palace burned, Xiangchun memorialized in protest, and the court took note.

sentences.zh: 時宗室繁衍，歲祿不繼，象春議變通。

translations.literal: At the time the imperial clan had grown numerous and annual stipends could not keep pace; Xiangchun proposed flexible measures.
translations.idiomatic: As the imperial house multiplied and yearly allotments fell short, Xiangchun urged adaptive reforms.

sentences.zh: 會河南巡撫褚鈇亦奏其事，帝即命象春遍詣河南、山西、陜西諸王府，計畫以聞。

translations.literal: When Grand Coordinator Chu Tie of Henan also memorialized on the matter, the emperor at once ordered Xiangchun to visit in turn the princely establishments of Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi and report plans.
translations.idiomatic: When Henan grand coordinator Chu Tie submitted a similar memorial, the emperor immediately sent Xiangchun through the Henan, Shanxi, and Shaanxi princely houses to devise measures and report back.

sentences.zh: 象春抵河南，方集議，而周府諸宗人疑鈇疏出宗正睦㮮意，群毆睦㮮幾死。
